en.title: Ladders in Chaos: When, How, (and Perhaps Why) Does Test-Time Scaling Improve LLM Machine Translation

key_takeaways: Compares sequential and parallel test-time scaling paradigms in LLMs
Identifies the exact conditions under which scaling improves translation
Provides actionable insights for optimizing LLM inference performance
